```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)

payload <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$payload_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)

esc_html <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L || is.na(x)) return("")
  s <- as.character(x)
  s <- gsub("&", "&amp;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("<", "&lt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub(">", "&gt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub('"', "&quot;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s
}

render_edatopic_svg <- function(cells_list, title_text) {
  snrs <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")
  rows <- as.character(0:8)
  cell_w <- 48L
  cell_h <- 28L
  pad_l <- 48L
  pad_t <- 42L
  w <- pad_l + length(snrs) * cell_w + 16L
  h <- pad_t + length(rows) * cell_h + 18L

  max_cnt <- 1L
  cell_map <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())
  if (!is.null(cells_list)) {
    for (ci in cells_list) {
      k <- paste0(as.character(ci$smr), "|", toupper(as.character(ci$snr)))
      cnt <- as.integer(ci$count)
      if (cnt > max_cnt) max_cnt <- cnt
      assign(k, cnt, envir = cell_map)
    }
  }

  parts <- c(
    sprintf('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" width="%d" height="%d" role="img" aria-label="%s">', w, h, w, h, esc_html(title_text)),
    sprintf('<rect x="0" y="0" width="%d" height="%d" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d8d8d8" rx="3"/>', w, h),
    sprintf('<text x="%d" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">%s</text>', as.integer(w / 2), esc_html(title_text))
  )
  for (ci in seq_along(snrs)) {
    cx <- pad_l + (ci - 1L) * cell_w + (cell_w / 2.0)
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="35" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#313132">%s</text>', cx, snrs[[ci]]))
  }
  for (ri in seq_along(rows)) {
    ry <- pad_t + (ri - 1L) * cell_h
    r_lbl <- rows[[ri]]
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%.1f" text-anchor="end" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#313132">%s</text>', pad_l - 6L, ry + cell_h * 0.66, r_lbl))
    for (ci in seq_along(snrs)) {
      cx <- pad_l + (ci - 1L) * cell_w
      k <- paste0(r_lbl, "|", snrs[[ci]])
      cnt <- if (exists(k, envir = cell_map, inherits = FALSE)) get(k, envir = cell_map) else 0L
      fill <- "#f8fafc"
      txt <- "#64748b"
      stroke <- "#cbd5e1"
      sw <- "0.8"
      if (cnt > 0L) {
        ratio <- cnt / max_cnt
        if (ratio >= 0.7) {
          fill <- "#003366"
          txt <- "#ffffff"
          stroke <- "#FCBA19"
          sw <- "1.5"
        } else if (ratio >= 0.35) {
          fill <- "#38598A"
          txt <- "#ffffff"
        } else {
          fill <- "#dbeafe"
          txt <- "#003366"
        }
      }
      parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<rect x="%d" y="%d" width="%d" height="%d" fill="%s" stroke="%s" stroke-width="%s"/>', cx, ry, cell_w, cell_h, fill, stroke, sw))
      if (cnt > 0L) {
        parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="%.1f" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="%s">%d</text>', cx + cell_w / 2.0, ry + cell_h * 0.66, txt, cnt))
      }
    }
  }
  paste(c(parts, "</svg>"), collapse = "\n")
}

render_aspect_rose_svg <- function(sectors_list) {
  labels <- c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")
  counts <- integer(8L)
  if (!is.null(sectors_list)) {
    for (s_item in sectors_list) {
      idx <- match(toupper(as.character(s_item$sector)), labels)
      if (!is.na(idx)) counts[[idx]] <- as.integer(s_item$count)
    }
  }
  max_c <- max(1L, counts)
  cx <- 120L
  cy <- 125L
  r_max <- 76.0

  parts <- c(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 245" width="240" height="245" role="img" aria-label="Aspect Rose">',
    '<rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="245" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d8d8d8" rx="3"/>',
    '<text x="120" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">Aspect Rose (8-Sector)</text>',
    sprintf('<circle cx="%d" cy="%d" r="%.1f" fill="none" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>', cx, cy, r_max * 0.5),
    sprintf('<circle cx="%d" cy="%d" r="%.1f" fill="none" stroke="#cbd5e1"/>', cx, cy, r_max)
  )
  for (i in seq_len(8L)) {
    ang_deg <- (i - 1L) * 45.0 - 90.0
    a1 <- (ang_deg - 18.0) * pi / 180.0
    a2 <- (ang_deg + 18.0) * pi / 180.0
    rad <- if (counts[[i]] > 0L) max(10.0, (counts[[i]] / max_c) * r_max) else 0.0
    if (rad > 0.0) {
      parts <- c(parts, sprintf(
        '<path d="M %d %d L %.1f %.1f A %.1f %.1f 0 0 1 %.1f %.1f Z" fill="#003366" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="#FCBA19" stroke-width="1.2"/>',
        cx, cy, cx + rad * cos(a1), cy + rad * sin(a1), rad, rad, cx + rad * cos(a2), cy + rad * sin(a2)
      ))
    }
    am <- ang_deg * pi / 180.0
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf(
      '<text x="%.1f" y="%.1f" text-anchor="middle" font-family="BC Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#313132">%s (%d)</text>',
      cx + (r_max + 15.0) * cos(am), cy + (r_max + 15.0) * sin(am) + 3.5, labels[[i]], counts[[i]]
    ))
  }
  paste(c(parts, "</svg>"), collapse = "\n")
}
```

```{r header_block, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("<h2>%s</h2>\n", esc_html(payload$title)))
cat(sprintf(
  "<p><strong>Project:</strong> %s &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Site Unit:</strong> %s &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>BGC:</strong> %s &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Plots (n):</strong> %d &nbsp;|&nbsp; <strong>Climate Normal:</strong> %s</p>\n",
  esc_html(payload$project),
  esc_html(payload$targetUnit),
  esc_html(payload$bgcLabel),
  as.integer(payload$plotCount),
  esc_html(payload$refPeriod)
))
if (!is.null(payload$conceptNotes) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(payload$conceptNotes)))) {
  cat(sprintf("<blockquote>%s</blockquote>\n", esc_html(payload$conceptNotes)))
}
```

### Edatopic Grids and Topographic Position

```{r edatopic_block, results='asis'}
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  cat('<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:16px;">\n')
  cat(render_edatopic_svg(payload$relativeGrid, "Relative Edatope (rSMR x rSNR)"))
  cat(render_edatopic_svg(payload$actualGrid, "Actual Edatope (aSMR x rSNR)"))
  cat(render_aspect_rose_svg(payload$aspectRose))
  cat("</div>\n")
}
```

```{r env_summary_table}
if (!is.null(payload$envStats) && length(payload$envStats) > 0L) {
  env_rows <- lapply(payload$envStats, function(r) {
    data.frame(
      Metric = as.character(r$metric),
      N = as.integer(r$n),
      Min = as.numeric(r$min),
      Q1 = as.numeric(r$q1),
      Median = as.numeric(r$median),
      Q3 = as.numeric(r$q3),
      Max = as.numeric(r$max),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, env_rows), caption = "Topographic and Climatic Five-Number Summaries")
}
```

### Characteristic Vegetation Synthesis

```{r veg_table}
if (!is.null(payload$vegetationTable) && length(payload$vegetationTable) > 0L) {
  veg_rows <- lapply(payload$vegetationTable, function(r) {
    data.frame(
      Strata = as.character(r$layer),
      Code = as.character(r$species),
      `Scientific Name` = as.character(r$scientificName),
      `English Name` = as.character(r$englishName),
      `Presence Class` = as.character(r$constancyClass),
      `Constancy (%)` = round(as.numeric(r$constancyPct), 1),
      `Mean Cover (%)` = round(as.numeric(r$meanCover), 1),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, veg_rows))
} else {
  cat("No species met the minimum constancy threshold.")
}
```
